hypothesis: tornado.escape.xhtml_escape does not escape single quotes, so a string containing an apostrophe is returned unchanged, violating the documented behavior that xhtml_escape escapes all HTML-special characters including single quotes.
trigger: Call tornado.escape.xhtml_escape("'") and assert the result equals '''.
potential_failure: xhtml_escape returns "'" instead of ''', leaving single quotes unescaped in HTML attribute contexts.

oracle.expected_behavior: tornado.escape.xhtml_escape("'") should return ''' because xhtml_escape is documented to escape HTML-special characters, and single quotes are HTML-special in attribute contexts.
oracle.target_evidence: tornado/escape.py defines xhtml_escape and its docstring states it escapes HTML-special characters; the implementation uses a regex substitution table that historically includes ''' for single quotes. The ordinary test tornado/test/escape_test.py contains test_xhtml_escape which asserts xhtml_escape("'\"") == ''"'.
